about_short_description.short_description: Vega Security offers cybersecurity services for cyberattack detection.

product.name: Security Analytics Mesh (SAM)
product.description: A security analytics platform that connects to enterprise data in place and supports federated detection, threat hunting, and automated alert triage without requiring data ingestion or migration.

product.name: Federated Analytics
product.description: AI-native security analytics that queries data across SIEMs, cloud logs, data lakes, object storage, and other sources in place, without copying or migrating telemetry.

product.name: Agentic Detection
product.description: A detection engineering capability that deploys detections across connected data sources and continuously evaluates coverage, accuracy, and relevance against MITRE ATT&CK.

product.name: Agentic Triage
product.description: AI-assisted alert investigation that autonomously examines alerts across connected enterprise data, performs enrichment and correlation, and produces investigation verdicts.

product.name: Incident Response Readiness
product.description: A security assessment service that evaluates detection coverage, identifies visibility and detection gaps, and helps organizations prepare for incident response.
